SELECT
FROM supplier_sku ss WHERE ss.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND ss.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY ss.id

SELECT
FROM supplier_sku ss WHERE ss.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND ss.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY ss.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT
FROM supplier_sku ss JOIN supplier s ON s.id = ss.supplier_id AND s.deleted = FALSE AND s.status = 'ENABLED' JOIN product_sku k ON k.id = ss.sku_id AND k.deleted = FALSE AND k.status = 'ON_SHELF' JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.status = 'ON_SHELF' WHERE ss.sku_id = #{skuId} AND ss.deleted = FALSE AND ss.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY ss.is_default DESC, ss.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier_sku WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT ss.supplier_id AS supplierId, COUNT(*) AS skuCount FROM supplier_sku ss WHERE ss.deleted = FALSE AND ss.supplier_id IN #{id} GROUP BY ss.supplier_id

SELECT k.id AS sku_id, k.sku_code, p.name AS product_name, k.spec_values FROM product_sku k JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.status = 'ON_SHELF' WHERE k.deleted = FALSE AND k.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND k.id IN #{id}
